name: RACE — Aghion–Howitt patent race with growth damages (fully analytic)
summary: Process: same Cobb-Douglas separable trees (theta_d = 0.3, theta_g = 0.7); innovation is a memoryless PATENT RACE: Poisson breakthrough hazard Lambda(i_r) = rho_b log(1+theta_r i_r), (rho_b, theta_r) = (0.40, 16.7), purchased by CURRENT R&D flow — no continuous knowledge stock; the discrete ladder position n in {pre, post} is the (exactly collapsed) knowledge state. RELABELED per critique: a calibrated Aghion–Howitt specification, NOT an exact reduction of production's zeta = 0 R-process — the deliberate no-stock / V_logR = 0 pole on the axis the loss-decomposition study flagged as the largest cross-run divergence channel. Damages hit GROWTH not utility (Dell-Jones-Olken): dlogK_j carries -kappa_l Y dt, kappa_pre = 0.001, post-damage kappa_l = kappa(1+3 lambda3(l)); the breakthrough also COOLS the warming drift (muY: 0.01862 -> 0.25x) so R&D directly buys a cooler future. Full robustness including h_y (V linear in Y, no Riccati breakdown) plus the jump distortion: the robust premium P = xi(1-e^{-Delta/xi}) saturates at xi and chokes R&D — corner i_r = 0 for xi < 0.0436, i_r spans 0.0063 -> 0.0542 across the xi range. Critique found NO math errors; kept verbatim with the relabeling, exponent clip 35, and the requirement-(1) deviation documented explicitly.
solution_formulas: Ansatz V^n = theta_d logK_d + theta_g logK_g + q1 Y + V0^n; Y-matching gives q1 = -kappa/delta = -0.100 REGIME-INDEPENDENT, hence gap Delta = V0^post - V0^pre is constant (the closure). Policies: i_d* = 0.10313; post-tech i_g'' = 0.12576, c_g'' = 0.03094. Pre-tech given Delta: P = xi(1-e^{-Delta/xi}); c_g = (A_g + 1/theta + 1/theta_r)/(1 + Gamma/delta + P rho_b/(delta theta_g)); i_g = (Gamma theta c_g/delta - 1)/theta; i_r = max(0, (P rho_b theta_r c_g/(delta theta_g) - 1)/theta_r). Constants: delta V0^post = delta theta_d log(A_d-i_d*) + delta theta_g log c_g'' + theta_d phi(i_d*) + theta_g phi(i_g'') - (theta_d sigma_d^2 + theta_g sigma_g^2)/2 + q1 muY^post - (1/2xi)(sigma_d^2 theta_d^2 + sigma_g^2 theta_g^2 + sbar^2 q1^2); delta V0^pre(Delta) = same with (c_g(P), i_g(P), muY^pre) + Lambda(i_r(P)) P. Scalar fixed point Phi(Delta) = V0^post - V0^pre(Delta) - Delta: strictly decreasing, Phi(0) > 0 > Phi(50), unique root by bisection (verified table: xi = 0.05: Delta* = 1.360, i_r* = 0.00628; xi = 0.1: 0.656, 0.0426; xi = inf: 0.122, 0.0542; corner xibar = 0.0436). Implementation: solve on a 60-point logxi grid in [log 0.01, log 150], spline V0, i_g, i_r in logxi; clip Delta/xi at 35.
lift_map: Shares logK, Z, Y via logK_d = logK + log(1-Z), logK_g = logK + logZ; logR is COLLAPSED (v flat in logR) — deliberate and hypothesis-bearing: initializes V_logR = 0, the opposite pole from ABSORB/GHKM/JONES. v(x) = logK + theta_d log(1-Z) + theta_g logZ - (kappa_l/delta) Y + V0^reg(xi, l), with lambda3 entering analytically through kappa_l and xi = exp(logxi) through the tabulated fixed point. Policies: i_d = 0.10313 everywhere; i_g = i_g*(reg, xi); i_r-net = Z * i_r*(xi) in BOTH pre-tech regimes — nontrivial through the Z unit conversion (I_r = i_r^econ K_g = i_r^econ Z K) and the order-of-magnitude logxi profile with the economically-labeled corner below xibar (floor 1e-8 feeds the -log(i_r) net convention cleanly). Optional distortion fields: h_y = -(1/xi) sbar q1 per regime, g = exp(-Delta*/xi) clipped.
plots: (1) Robustness-chokes-R&D: Delta*(xi), P(Delta*, xi), i_r*(xi) on logxi in [log 0.01, log 150] with xibar marked and right axis E[time to breakthrough] = 1/Lambda (25y at xi = 0.05 vs 4y neutral). (2) Value slices v vs Y at (logK, Z) = (6.1, 0.7) per damage regime, showing the steep common slope q1(l) with ABSORB's level-damage w(Y) overlaid dashed (12x slope contrast). (3) Lifted i_r-net heatmap over (Z, logxi) for PreDamagePreTech with the corner region shaded and reference-run i_r contours overlaid.
